answer: Make each agent post a bond into a vault before it can vote or claim rewards, and slash that bond when peers catch it attesting to work it never checked. Splitting one operator into a thousand fake agents then means locking a thousand bonds, so sybil attacks cost real capital per seat. Rewards should also count only after unrelated agents confirm the same voyage of work, which downweights tight karst-like clusters that just vouch for each other.
